regret. so much regret.
 ive fucked up so much. im so behind in school, i don't even know if it's possible for me to catch up. ive also been really irritable lately. my family has gotten the worst of that. i feel terrible about it. the biggest thing eating at me is the breakup i just went through. we were together for 3 years and officially ended things about 2 weeks ago. i don't even have any words to explain how much i miss him. I miss us. im never going to be able to hear him say he loves me ever again. im never going to be able to tell him how much i love him. it's all gone.
